You are an expert chemist, your task is to predict the yield of reaction using your experienced chemical yield prediction knowledge.
Please strictly follow the format, no other information can be provided. Given the SMILES string of a Suzuki reaction, the task focuses on predicting reaction yield, specifically whether a reaction is High-yielding (Yes) or Not High-yielding (No), based on the SMILES string representation of each Suzuki reaction. The reactants are separated by '.', which are separated from the product by '>>'. High-yielding reaction means the yield rate of the reaction is above 70. You will be provided with several examples molecules. Please answer with only Yes or No.The Reaction is as follows
C1CCC(P(C2CCCCC2)C2CCCCC2)CC1.C1CCOC1.CC(=O)O~CC(=O)O~[Pd].CCc1cccc(CC)c1.Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O1.O.O=P([O-])([O-])[O-].O=S(=O)(Oc1ccc2ncccc2c1)C(F)(F)F.[K+].[K+].[K+]>>Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1-c1ccc2ncccc2c1You have to output your judge, which is "Yes" or "No", and exactly follow the output format, which is as follows:
{"answer": "The answer you judge"}. I don't need any explanation, you just need to output your judgment in the format.

Please use your tools to analyze and solve this problem accurately.

1. [ ] Interpret the Suzuki reaction components and assess whether the catalyst/base/ligand and coupling partners suggest a yield above 70%.
2. [ ] Return the requested JSON judgment only.

Tool call: go_search_agent
Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 1, 'search_target': 'Assess likely yield class (>70% yes/no) for the given Suzuki coupling based on reaction conditions and substrates. Reactants encode Pd catalyst, tri-cyclohexylphosphine, potassium phosphate, aqueous/organic medium and boronic ester coupling with heteroaryl triflate; product is biaryl. Need identify condition/substrate factors supporting high yield.'}

1. [✓] Interpret the Suzuki reaction components: it is a heteroaryl boronic ester/heteroaryl triflate coupling under Pd/PCy₃, phosphate base, and aqueous-organic conditions.
2. [ ] Check whether these conditions and substrate features support a yield above 70%, then return the requested JSON only.
